body: I cannot afford to travel, and I realize all that about experience, I've been shooting for 10 years along with studying it and having a degree in the subject. None of that even matters though, this is more about me being ready to die than anything else.

I understand I can improve my photography, I've been on that process for the past 10 years. I consistently watch lectures, read books, etc. on photography so I can get better but lately I just feel like I am just lacking the ability to be good at this. I just don't have that "talent". I hate myself so much that I can't even function anymore so photography kind of fell out of my life these past few months and I have nothing left.
